node.statement: Fix 0 != Z in S_P and write T=Z^dagger dot Z. Validated nodes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 at n=1 give ||h_1(Z)||^2 >= ||h_1(T)||-C_prod e||Z||^2. If T != 0, the definition of a_1 gives ||h_1(T)|| >= a_1||T||; if T=0, the same inequality holds because its right side is zero and a norm is nonnegative. Validated node 1.4.2.1.1 gives ||T|| >= (1-K_sq e)||Z||^2. Since a_1>=0, combination yields ||h_1(Z)||^2 >= ((1-K_sq e)a_1-C_prod e)||Z||^2.
